facts: After the fall of Rome, human survival often became more important than breeding and training dogs. Legends of werewolves emerged during this time as abandoned dogs traveling in packs commonly roamed streets and terrified villagers.
Perky-eared dogs hear sounds better than floppy-eared dogs.
Dogs can get jealous when their humans display affection toward someone or something else.
The most popular breed of dog in the US is the Labrador Retriever.
Dogs can be trained to detect cancer and alert their owner.
